comment: Per-stage wall-time budgets for the release train, in seconds (cas-2bef). release-metrics.py compares each completed stage in stage-events.tsv with its budget; commit-to-main is the worst task's park to the main commit that landed it. A breach is measured for the nightly scorecard and never auto-files a task. Loosening a budget is a reviewed change to this file. Targets come from epic cas-a229: commit to main within 30 minutes, main to published within 20.
